extra.selection_rule: from the 7811 official-train clips that carry at least one action segment, pick 1400 with an even stride over the lexicographically sorted video ids (idx_i=floor(i*N/n)); split into 70/15/15 by contiguous blocks of that sorted selection (Charades ids are random 5-char strings so id order is effectively random; the split unit is the video id)
extra.class_rule: the 50 most frequent action classes among the selected clips, each with >= 60 annotated segments

class_names.c151: Someone is going from standing to sitting
class_names.c154: Someone is standing up from somewhere

extra.sampling: 128 uniformly spaced frame indices per clip over the container frame count (endpoints inclusive); shorter clips keep all frames

labels.lab_event: [T,C] float32 multi-label: class c is 1 at frame t iff t lies in an annotated [onset, offset) segment of class c (real temporal boundaries from the CSV)
labels.lab_seg: [T] int64 onset indicator: 1 if any annotated segment starts in (t_{f-1}, t_f]
